sources.title: Ouijit README
sources.locator: Intro; Tasks and worktrees; Working with agents; Sandboxing; Setup; Supported harnesses
sources.finding: Task and terminal manager for parallel coding agents: kanban board, one git worktree per task (copy-on-write), lifecycle hooks, session-aware ouijit CLI, diff review with notes, GitHub PR inbox and GitHub/Linear issues list (experimental), lenses, nono sandbox, session resume, local REST API and SQLite; macOS 13+ and Linux x64; AGPL-3.0, no account, no telemetry.

sources.title: Ouijit FAQ
sources.locator: faqs array (OS support, free, agents, isolation, sandbox)
sources.finding: FAQ states macOS 13+ and Linux x64, free with no paid tier, Claude Code/Codex/Pi/OpenCode get live status and the CLI reference, worktrees under ~/Ouijit/worktrees with copy-on-write, nono sandbox.

sources.title: Docs: Getting started
sources.finding: Requires macOS 13+ or Linux x64, git 2.20+ and an agent CLI (claude, codex, pi or opencode); Linux deb and zip.

sources.title: Docs: Tasks and worktrees
sources.locator: Task lifecycle table; Branch from; Merge targets; Copy-on-write cloning; creation modes
sources.finding: Four statuses (To Do, In Progress, In Review, Done), per-task branch and worktree under ~/Ouijit/worktrees, merge targets for chaining, Quick start (CoW clone of ignored files) or Clean checkout modes, trash deletes branch and moves worktree to trash.

sources.title: Docs: Hooks
sources.finding: Start, continue, review and done hooks run on status changes with OUIJIT_TASK_* environment; run command and editor commands run on demand.

sources.title: Docs: For agents
sources.locator: What an agent receives; Drive the board; Review without posting; Inside a sandbox
sources.finding: Supported harnesses get the ouijit CLI reference in their system prompt; agents resolve and move their own task; hooks asked of the user wait in a queue; PR and Linear comments are staged locally as drafts; per-session API token.

sources.title: Docs: CLI
sources.locator: Tasks; Hooks; Terminals; Diff notes; Your queue; Pull requests; Issues; Environment variables
sources.finding: ouijit CLI talks to a localhost API with a per-session token and prints JSON; commands for tasks, hooks, terminals, diff notes, links, queue asks, tags, scripts, PR drafts, issues, panels, themes and projects.

sources.title: Docs: Sandbox
sources.locator: Where things run; Ouijit CLI in a sandbox; nono; Custom
sources.finding: Per-project default Host, nono sandbox or Custom launcher; nono uses Seatbelt on macOS and Landlock (kernel 5.13+) on Linux, limits files to the worktree and git data; Custom launcher owns the boundary; CLI access levels read-only, own task, everything.

sources.title: Docs: Pull requests and issues
sources.locator: Turn it on; Work the inbox; Add Linear; Work the issues
sources.finding: Experimental per-project: PR inbox, review threads, staged review comments, merge and a combined GitHub/Linear issues list; drives the gh CLI, no GitHub token stored; Linear key stored in the OS keychain.

sources.title: Docs: Diff review
sources.locator: Pick a base; Read it through a lens; Leave notes for the agent
sources.finding: Per-worktree diff with word-level highlighting, selectable base, lenses that group a change, notes anchored to code that are pasted into the agent prompt.

sources.title: Docs: Terminals
sources.finding: Sidebar lists projects, tasks and terminals with agent status dots; stacked terminal cards; keyboard shortcuts including command palette and board.

sources.title: Docs: Panels
sources.finding: Terminal panels: runner for scripts, web preview and rendered markdown files.

sources.title: Docs: Supported agents
sources.finding: Claude Code, Codex, Pi and OpenCode get live status and CLI awareness only in Ouijit terminals; sound and OS notification when a turn ends.
